FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS FOR 
SELF-PROPELLED GANTRY FOR LIFTING AIR CARGO CONTAINERS 

AND OUTSIZE CARGOES 



1 . Scope — Specifies the functional requirements for a self-propelled gantry capable of raising from 
the ground, transporting and stacking two high: 

a) Corner fitting equipped air/surface intermodal containers according to IS:7917 (Part 1 )-1975 
'Air cargo freight containers: Part 1 General requirements' and IS :7917 (Part 2)-1975 'Air 
cargo freight containers: Part 2 Testing' with the following characteristics:

2. General 

2.1 The term 'weight' is retained here above, instead of the correct technical term 'mass' in order to 
conform to current commercial usage. 

2.2 The methods and devices used to lift corner fitting containers with the unit shall comply with 
IS : 7622-1975 'Guide for handling of ISO freight containers'. 

3. Structure and Overall Dimensions 

Note — See Fig. 1 for explanation of specification clearance. 

3.1 The unit shall basically consist of two gantry frames connected together by structural members 
so that the nominal distance between both gantries be approximately 6 110 mm. It shall have a total 
of four hoisting points in order to provide adequate stability when lifting the load. 

3.2 The fully equipped unit shall provide for a minimum 5 500 mm clear lifting height. This minimum 
clear height shall be maintained when remote controlled top lifting spreader option (5eeFig. 2) is 
adopted.

3.3 The urit shall provide for a minimum 3 660 mm internal clear'width.

3.4 The overall dimensions of tlie unit shall be kept to a minimum. Particularly, the overall width of 
the unit shall not exceed 5 180 mm. 

3.5 When loaded, the unit shall have adequate clearance underneath from any portion of the equipment 
to the ground when negotiating two ramps that intersect at b°. 

4. Lifting Function 

4.1 The unit shall be equipped with a remote controlled top lifting spreader for 6 058 mm containers, 
attached to the four hoisting points referred to in 3.1. It shall include provisions to allow either a 
fast replacement of 6 058 mm spreader by a 12 192 mm one, or the installation of an adjustable 
spreader to handle 6 058 mm and 1 2 1 92 mm containers. 

4.2 Exterior, self-centring, gather devices shall be provided atthefour upper corner fittings to ensure 
accurate positioning of the spreader for direct top lifting. They shall impinge on the corner fittings 
only. The location of the remote controlled twistlocks to engage the corner fittings shall allow for 
a minimum of 50 mm clearance between the top of the container and any part of the spreader 
structure (see Fig. 2). 



4.3 In addition, the spreader shall be equipped with 
attachment points, located in accordance with Fig. 3. 



a minimum of eight lifting slings or chains

FIG. 3 NOMINAL LOCATION OF THE EIGHT LIFTING SLING/CHAiN ATTACHMENT POINTS 



Such slings or chains shall be used; 

a) either to lift a 6 058 mm container from its bottom corner fittings, as an alternate method, 
when either the upper corner fittings or the spreader remote controlled twistlocks are 
unserviceable; 

b) or to lift a 6 058 mm pallet or other non-corner fitting equipped ULD, through adequate 
attachment devices; and 

c) or to lift various pieces of outsize cargo. 

4.4 The system of slings or chains shall be designed to avoid any interference between the slings or 
chains and the container structures. The devices engaging and lifting the container shall be designed 
to avoid any damage to cast aluminium corner fittings. 

4.5 The gantry and spreader design, as well as the length and slings or chains design, when used 
between the spreader and the load shall allow stacking 2 438 mm high containers on two levels. 

4.6 For maintenance purposes or in order to allow interchange of various spreaders, it shall be 
possible to deposit the spreader or to pick it up on/from the ground. 



18:12462-1988 

4.7 A variety of ( additional ) sling attachment points, as specified by the buyer, shall be provided 
on the spreader to allow safe slinging and lifting of various pieces of outsize cargo to be handled. 

4.8 Provisions for using common lifting hardware shall be made to that effect, 

4.8.1 An adjustable lifting speed, preferably in the range of 1'83 to 5'50 m/min under the maximum 
load of 267 kN ( 27 200 kg ) shall be provided. 

4.9 The lifting speed shall be the same when hoisting or lowering. 

4.9.1 It shall be possible to raise each end of the container or outsize load independently. 

4.10 Lateral spreader movement shall be provided over a total range not less than 610 mm. The 
lateral movement speed shall be adjustable from to at least 0'61 m/min. Lateral movement of fore 
and aft ends of spreader shall be independently and/or simultaneously controlled. 

4.11 Statutory safety regulations relating to mobile lifting equipment shall be applied. 

5. Mobility and Stability 

5.1 Ground stabilizers or stabilizing devices shall not be necessary for the operation of the unit. 

5.2 In order to provide adequate stability, the unit's wheel base shall be equal or exceed 6 058 mm. 

5.3 The unit shall be capable of being driven with the maximum load of 267 kN (27 200 kg) at 
speed up to 10 km/h for at least 3 km. The units shall effectively and safely control the maximum 
load up to the maximum driving speed. 

5.4 Power steering shall be provided. 

5.5 The unloaded unit shall be able to start moving on a 5° slope. 

5.6 The swept turn radius, measured at the outermost part shall be kept to a minimum and shall not 
exceed 9*15 m (not including the spreader), if designed for 12 192 mm container capacity. 

5.7 The unloaded unit in the raised position shall be safe in wind velocities up to 193 km/h. 

5.8 The wheel footprint shall be such that pressure on the ground does not exceed 14 bar* when the 
unit is loaded with the maximum load of 267 kN ( 27 200 kg ). 

6. Controls 

6.1 All controls necessary to move and operate the unit shall be located in the driver's position. 

6.2 In addition, an electrical remote control box of minimum weight and size and of the type most 
currently used on lifting gantries, may be provided on the size of the unit opposite to the driver's 
position, for lifting functions only. 

6.3 Ample lighting is required for night operations and to illuminate the load and close surroundings. 

6.4 Normal power system warnings and indicator lights shall be provided. 



*1 Bar = 105 N/m2. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In order to achieve international coordination on the subject, this standard is based on 
ISO 6965-1982 'Air craft-Self-propelled gantry for lifting air cargo containers and outsize cargoes- 
Functional requirements', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO).
